notes.title: Archrobo will be free in around 1 week
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've decided to make Archrobo free in around 1 week (I can't give an exact time because I'm not sure how long it takes Steam to change from paid to free).

There are some issues/bugs with the game that I'm unable to fix. So I believe the best thing to do is to make the game free.

Apologies to anyone that paid for the game recently. Sorry for any inconvenience.

-Ameet Sharma
